reconcile_hint_exact_unticked: {name} ({amount}) is exactly the difference. Is it on the statement?
reconcile_hint_exact_ticked: {name} ({amount}) is exactly the difference. Is it really on the statement?
reconcile_hint_wrong_way_in: {name} is half the difference. Is it the wrong way round, money in rather than out?
reconcile_hint_wrong_way_out: {name} is half the difference. Is it the wrong way round, money out rather than in?
reconcile_hint_swapped: Was {name} {meant} rather than {amount}? Swapped digits are a common slip.
reconcile_hint_decimal: Was {name} {meant} rather than {amount}? The decimal point may be in the wrong place.
reconcile_hint_duplicate: {name} appears twice. Is one a duplicate?
reconcile_hint_late: Entries from the last days of the period can show on the next statement instead.
reconcile_hint_look_out: Look on the statement for a fee, a charge or interest of {amount} that isn't in Kosha yet.
reconcile_hint_look_in: Look on the statement for interest, a refund or a payment in of {amount} that isn't in Kosha yet.
reconcile_gap_opening: {next} opens at {opening}, but {previous} closes at {closing}. A statement may be missing.
reconcile_picker_sub: Check an account against your bank's statement, or import the statement.
reconcile_picker_empty: Add a bank account or card first.
reconcile_pdf_unsupported: Kosha reads CSV, OFX and QFX files. Export one of those from your bank.
reconcile_currency_mismatch: This statement is in {statementCurrency}, and {account} is in {currency}.
reconcile_ofx_empty: That OFX file has no transactions
reconcile_csv_empty: That file has no rows Kosha can read

match.countPlural=one: Pick a category for 1 line first
match.countPlural=other: Pick a category for {count} lines first

reconcile_hint_opening_gap: This statement opens at {opening}, but the last one you reconciled closed at {closing}. A statement in between may be missing.
reconcile_hint_single_missing: {payee} ({amount}) on the statement is exactly the difference. Add it to Kosha.

match.countPlural=one: Adding the line missing from Kosha closes the difference exactly.
match.countPlural=other: Adding the {count} lines missing from Kosha closes the difference exactly.

match.countPlural=one: 1 line on the statement isn't in Kosha yet ({amount}).
match.countPlural=other: {count} lines on the statement aren't in Kosha yet ({amount}).

reconcile_done_correction: A correction of {amount} closed the difference.
reconcile_done_marked: Kosha marks them reconciled and tells you before you change one.
reconcile_check_each: Check each entry against your bank's statement.
reconcile_drift: Entries reconciled on {day} have changed by {amount} since, so they no longer add up to that statement. One was edited or deleted; undo that reconciliation to check them again.
reconcile_pdf_off: The lines read from this PDF miss its closing balance by {amount}. A line may have been misread; check them against the PDF before adding any.
reconcile_drop: Drop your statement here, or {#choose}choose a file{/choose}
reconcile_drop_formats: CSV, OFX or QFX from your bank. Kosha ticks what matches and lists what's missing.
reconcile_drop_formats_pdf: CSV, OFX or QFX from your bank, or a PDF statement. Kosha ticks what matches and lists what's missing.
reconcile_quick_balance: Kosha shows {#amount}{amount}{/amount} today. Compare it with your bank's current balance, not the available one.
reconcile_quick_owed: Kosha shows you owe {#amount}{amount}{/amount} today. Compare it with your bank's current balance, not the available one.
reconcile_missing_title: On the statement, not in Kosha ({count})
reconcile_saving_teaches: Saving teaches Kosha these payee names for your next statement.
reconcile_close_title: Close, but not the same amount ({count})
reconcile_before_hint: Ticked, as they were on earlier statements
